language_note: Written in French: telenovela French, short punchy lines; the names, the Team question and the end card stay in French.

naming.rule: a French telenovela pun on the character's own species

roles.line: heads the family; her word is law until a secret cracks it
wants the inheritance or the power and hides it behind a smile
turns everyone against each other with her wits, never her body
trusts too fast; the one the audience wants to protect
stands to inherit everything, and may not be who they think
loyal and funny, and the first whose loyalty is tested
arrives with a secret that changes the family

guardrails: no one judged by body, looks or love life
plot_seeds: a betrayal revealed: the best friend has been lying from the start
an inheritance: the will names the wrong heir
a secret identity: the newcomer is family
a loyalty test: family or love
a family twist: two heirs swapped at birth
